title: go.mod, Textable
documentation:
## File type
The concrete file format. Each value identifies a single, well-known format with its
file extensions and MIME type. File-type is the identity-tag of file-format media URNs:
`media:pdf` carries the pdf file-type marker, `media:json;textable;record` carries the
json file-type marker.

The file-type dim is authored across multiple fragment files in `fabric/dims/file-type/`
grouped by category (image, audio, video, archive, document, source, font, model,
data, config, web, other). Fragment merging produces a single global file-type dim
catalogue.

Go module file. Declares module path and dependencies.

## Textable
Coercion marker indicating the value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text.
Strings are textable trivially; integers and booleans are textable via their
string form; structured values are textable when JSON-serialised. Binary blobs
(images, audio, raw bytes) are NOT textable — converting them to text requires
explicit transformation that may be lossy.

The value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text without loss.
